[
  {"sentence": 1, "status": "present", "evidence": "Prologue: on the sinking Lusitania an agitated man says 'it must be a woman... women and children first' and gives an American girl an oilskin packet of 'vitally important papers'; Carter later names him Danvers and her Jane Finn", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 2, "status": "present", "evidence": "'Tommy, old thing!' 'Tuppence, old bean!' meet at Dover Street Tube; Tommy demobbed; Tuppence is 'fifth daughter of Archdeacon Cowley' and did hospital work", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 3, "status": "present", "evidence": "Both are short of money and jobs; 'Trading under the name of the Young Adventurers, Ltd.?'; they draft an advertisement for hire", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 4, "status": "present", "evidence": "Whittington says 'I happened to overhear part of your conversation' and offers £100 to enter Madame Colombier's pensionnat in Paris", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 5, "status": "present", "evidence": "Tuppence says 'Jane Finn' and Whittington turns 'purple with rage'; he gives her 'fifty to go on with'; next day the Esthonia Glassware office is closed; Tommy had overheard the name in the street", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 6, "status": "present", "evidence": "'there are only two answers!'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 7, "status": "present", "evidence": "First letter signed 'A. CARTER'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 8, "status": "present", "evidence": "Tommy: 'I recognized you at once. Saw you in France when I was with the Intelligence'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 9, "status": "present", "evidence": "Carter explains the draft secret agreement 'implicates a number of our statesmen'; 'Bolshevist gold is pouring into this country to procure a Revolution'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 10, "status": "present", "evidence": "'He is always spoken of by the unassuming title of \"Mr. Brown.\"'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 11, "status": "present", "evidence": "'a certain man, whose real name is unknown to us'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 12, "status": "present", "evidence": "'How would you like to work for me?... Find Jane Finn'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 13, "status": "present", "evidence": "Second letter signed 'JULIUS P. HERSHEIMMER'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 14, "status": "present", "evidence": "Julius claims to be Jane's cousin; 'Inspector Brown' took the only photograph; afterwards 'All barriers went down' and they join forces", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 15, "status": "present", "evidence": "Tuppence reasons that Danvers was shadowed by a woman who may have been 'Rita' and checks the Lusitania survivor list", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 16, "status": "present", "evidence": "At 20 South Audley Mansions: 'Marguerite... She's mostly called that [Rita]'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 17, "status": "present", "evidence": "Tommy follows Boris to a Soho house, copies the knock, says 'Mr. Brown?' and is let in", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 18, "status": "present", "evidence": "He overhears the meeting with Number One, later identified as Kramenin; the strike date is 'The 29th'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 19, "status": "present", "evidence": "'A crashing blow descended on his head'; he later bargains: 'I believe that I can find them'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 20, "status": "present", "evidence": "Albert, the lift-boy, arranges the job; Tuppence goes in as a house-parlourmaid", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 21, "status": "present", "evidence": "Mrs. Vandemeyer hires 'Prudence Cooper' as house-parlourmaid", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 22, "status": "present", "evidence": "'Sir James Peel Edgerton... the famous K.C.' calls at the flat", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 23, "status": "present", "evidence": "'a change does no harm sometimes... Just a hint'; he later helps them", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 24, "status": "present", "evidence": "Mrs. Vandemeyer holds a revolver to her: 'I'll shoot you like a dog'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 25, "status": "present", "evidence": "Tuppence seizes the revolver and offers 'a hundred thousand' from her American millionaire friend", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 26, "status": "present", "evidence": "'Who is Mr. Brown?' 'Yes... I know'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 27, "status": "present", "evidence": "She faints on seeing Sir James and Julius; they keep a vigil; by morning she is dead, with 'an odour of chloral'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 28, "status": "present", "evidence": "Dr. Hall: 'Janet Vandemeyer' suffers 'complete loss of memory' and 'is no longer under my care'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 29, "status": "present", "evidence": "Julius proposes and says 'think it over until to-morrow'; Tuppence weeps 'I do love you so' over Tommy's photo; her note says 'Let's leave it till then'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 30, "status": "present", "evidence": "Telegram: 'Come at once, Moat House, Ebury, Yorkshire... TOMMY'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 31, "status": "present", "evidence": "Annette slips him a penknife, helps him escape and cries 'To Marguerite!'; at the Ritz he is told Miss Cowley has gone out", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 32, "status": "present", "evidence": "After a week at Ebury they are 'no nearer to discovering Tuppence's whereabouts'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 33, "status": "present", "evidence": "Telegram: 'Jane Finn found. Come Manchester... PEEL EDGERTON'; at the Holyhead cliff path the packet reads 'WITH THE COMPLIMENTS OF MR. BROWN'", "note": "The message appears in sympathetic ink rather than plain ink; this is minor and not a distortion"},
  {"sentence": 34, "status": "present", "evidence": "Her clothes are 'Washed up on the Yorkshire coast'; Tommy rages at Julius: 'I loved her'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 35, "status": "present", "evidence": "Annette's photograph is in Julius's drawer; his letter to Carter says 'that girl at Manchester was just a plant'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 36, "status": "present", "evidence": "Tommy: 'I kept my mind open between the two of them'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 37, "status": "present", "evidence": "He leaves Julius a note about the Argentine and lets Sir James see his letter; the original wire reveals Astley Priors, Gatehouse, Kent", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 38, "status": "present", "evidence": "'She'd never spell her name \"Twopence\"... Julius had seen it... but Sir James hadn't!'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 39, "status": "present", "evidence": "Julius holds Kramenin at gunpoint and makes him fetch both girls; Jane admits she has been 'fooling them all the time' for 'Five long years'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 40, "status": "present", "evidence": "Tommy sends the girls to Sir James: 'I was sure they'd fetch up at the house in Soho'; the papers are behind the picture of 'Marguerite with her casket of jewels'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 41, "status": "present", "evidence": "Jane takes the treaty from behind the picture; Sir James says 'I am Mr. Brown'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 42, "status": "present", "evidence": "He raises an automatic and is 'seized from behind'; Tommy and Julius had hidden behind the curtain in the recess", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 43, "status": "present", "evidence": "He raises 'the hand which bore the big signet ring' to his lips and dies amid 'an odour of bitter almonds'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 44, "status": "present", "evidence": "'Deprived of their chief, the organization fell to pieces'; the treaty is 'reduced to ashes'; 'It was to be Peace'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 45, "status": "present", "evidence": "At the Savoy supper Carter reads from the brown diary, Sir William accepts Tommy ('You're my heir'), and Jane is toasted", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 46, "status": "present", "evidence": "Julius proposes to Jane and she says 'I love you now, Julius'; in a taxi Tommy says 'You won't be able to get out of marrying me'", "note": ""},
  {"sentence": 47, "status": "present", "evidence": "'Marriage is called a haven... But do you know what I think it is?... A sport!'; Carter's diary entry notes the boy is 'hard to blind... to facts'", "note": ""}
]
